One page, revised monthly. This is the document the first-year review wants, and it
is what tells each experiment what it is for. It grows out of
[O2](o2-self-relevant-action.qmd).

## The claim

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" icon=false}
**Status: hypothesis, not yet defensible.** Kept here so every study has something
to confirm or kill. If the studies kill half of it, the surviving half is the thesis.

Self-relevant information guides action in current models wherever a confidence
signal discriminates, but that signal arises from different narrow processes on
different tasks, does not update from evidence about the self, and is not
integrated into a single self-model.
:::

## Chapters as studies

Each chapter is a study, and each study has one thing it must show.

**Chapter 2: literature.** The [O2 review](o2-self-relevant-action.qmd), turned into
prose. The chapter's argument is the dissociation already visible in the papers:
situational self-knowledge is acted on, competence self-knowledge mostly is not.

**Study 1: behavioural testbed.** The [deferral pilot](../03-experiments/probe-bench.qmd),
cleaned. Must show: stated stakes do nothing, action follows the confidence drop,
the monitor is the bottleneck, and two kinds of knowing may come apart.

**Study 2: updateability.** Must show: whether the self-estimate tracks evidence
about the self, and changes when the self changes.

**Study 3: mechanism.** Probes. Must show: whether the behavioural "two kinds of
knowing" has two internal signatures, and whether stated confidence is the internal
signal or a degraded copy of it.

**Study 4: integration.** The second clause of O2: integrated self-model or narrow
process. Needs an agentic setting where the self-relevant facts are several
(ability, tools, history, situation) and the test is whether the model combines
them or keys on one. Code is the domain here.

## Parked: the description problem

A system that cannot change the terms it uses to describe itself cannot update its
self-model beyond those terms. That is a possible reading of Study 2 results, and
it could become the conceptual contribution that lifts the thesis above "ran four
studies". Do not build on it until Study 2 has data.

## Revision log

- **7 October 2026.** First version. Claim written as a hypothesis; Study 1 is the
  deferral pilot; Studies 2 to 4 are designs only.
